projects.name: Personality Prediction Project
projects.description: A final year project on automated personality classification for e-recruitment. The system analyzes résumés and social media data to predict a candidate's personality, then recommends suitable job profiles.
highlights: Predicts candidate personality from résumés and social media data
Recommends suitable job profiles from the predicted personality

projects.name: injectbench
projects.description: A prompt-injection evaluation harness that reports attack success rate per attack class with Wilson 95% intervals. It uses ablation to measure which guardrail layers actually reduce attack success relative to the latency they add.
highlights: Five-class attack taxonomy, 400 seeded trials per class (2,000 total)
Flags a redundant guardrail layer: 0 of 2000 trials flipped, at an 11 ms cost
44 tests in about 2 s; regression_check usable as a CI gate

projects.name: fieldextract
projects.description: Document field extraction with per-field calibrated confidence. Each field is routed to human review at a cost-optimal threshold, so operations teams know which fields need a human. It runs on a seeded simulated extractor.
highlights: ECE cut from 0.0290 to 0.0048 (6.0x lower) after per-field isotonic calibration
Per-field routing costs 1.78x less than one global threshold for the same 4,817 reviews
0 planted PII strings leaked after redaction across 500 docs; 51 tests

projects.name: sigmaforge
projects.description: A Sigma detection-rule compiler that parses rules into a typed expression tree. It renders the tree as Splunk SPL, Elastic EQL, Microsoft KQL and SQLite SQL. The SQL backend is checked against a reference evaluator with property-based differential tests.
highlights: Compiles one backend-neutral tree to four query targets
684 tests with mypy --strict and a coverage gate
Rules a target cannot express are rejected with a stated reason

projects.name: reachable
projects.description: A CVE triage tool that checks static call-graph reachability from entry points to the vulnerable function. Each finding is reported as reachable, not-reachable or indeterminate, and the tool never reports a silent 'safe'.
highlights: Demo app: 2 reachable, 1 indeterminate, 5 not reachable advisories
One added getattr() turns all not-reachable verdicts into indeterminate
CI gate and SARIF 2.1.0 output; standard library only

projects.name: lineagelens
projects.description: A column-level SQL lineage and impact analysis tool. It resolves SELECT *, CTEs and UNIONs to show exactly which downstream columns and dashboards break when a source column changes.
highlights: 10 models touch orders, but only 6 columns and 4 of 5 dashboards read discount_pct
Unexpandable stars are surfaced as unresolved, never silently dropped
18 tests plus Node.js tests for the browser demo

projects.name: p2pexceptions
projects.description: Procure-to-pay invoice exception analysis that classifies each failed three-way match into one cause from a mutually exclusive, exhaustive taxonomy. The classifier is validated against labelled cases, and causes are ranked in a cost-weighted Pareto.
highlights: 400,000 synthetic invoice lines, 72,739 failing three-way match (18.2%)
99.6% agreement with a labelled sample of 800; 0.00% unclassified
24 tests covering each precedence rule

projects.name: cuped
projects.description: A CUPED variance-reduction library for A/B tests that refuses covariates measured after randomisation. Its validation gate tests that bias case explicitly, using a balance check across arms.
highlights: 38.7% of variance removed; interval width 0.848 to 0.664
Gate rejects a post-treatment covariate that returned -6.601 against a true 1.80

projects.name: controlmap
projects.description: SOC 2 evidence automation that collects exports from GitHub, AWS, identity and HR systems and evaluates YAML controls against them. Controls are mapped to SOC 2 criteria, and the tool builds a hashed evidence package an auditor can verify.
highlights: 6 built-in collectors and 22 built-in rules
Library validated against 61 TSC criteria ids and 93 Annex A controls
Evidence package checkable with shasum, with an optional Ed25519 signature
